_doc: Boot profiles of tools/resident (copy to $RESIDENT_DIR/profiles.json, fill the overlay paths; the real file is never tracked). Keys: intent (xrun --intent or null), xrun (extra xrun flags), args (boot-args), names (more sweetnull= program names; devd is always added), overlay (a tree with System/Library/xpc/launchd.plist; devd is staged into a copy), launchd_base (a plist when the overlay has none), ready (regexes the boot log must show before jobs start: the GPU boot nav unlocks the phone, hot navs need that; missing after ready_s = GAP), ready_s. A job picks one with --profile NAME, or --profile any (default: runs on whatever boot is up; a fresh session boots default_profile).
